messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the cross-region retry spike at ~09:30 UTC. Putting owners and short AIs here.

riley: TL;DR root cause?

sam: Two things overlapped: a low-ttl DNS rotation and a route-table change that briefly sent traffic to a legacy pool without the new SNI mapping. Clients retried and some hit fallback pools, creating amplification.

toni: Any log examples?

net-oncall: Sample from 09:31:10-09:33:00 shows TLS_ALERT=40 and mismatched SNI in a subset. Example: `[09:31:22] src=10.0.2.14 dst=lb-us-04 TLS_ALERT=40 expected_sni=svc.prod.v4 actual_sni=svc.prod`.

sam: Draft AIs: AI-701 rollback route reorder (owner: riley) ETA 2h; AI-702 add SNI health probe + heuristic to mark legacy pools UNHEALTHY (owner: toni) ETA EOD; AI-703 control-plane TTL guard RFC (owner: net-oncall) ETA 2w; AI-704 alert for cross-region TLS handshake spikes (owner: sam) ETA 24h.

riley: Taking AI-701, will coordinate an out-of-band rollback.

deploy-bot: @riley scheduled rollback at 11:05 UTC, CI passed.

toni: Taking AI-702, branch feat/sni-probe created. Heuristic: mark pool UNHEALTHY after 3 SNI mismatches within 60s.

net-oncall: I'll draft AI-703 RFC; plan is to pause registrar rotations for a hostname while a rollout is active (+30s guard).

sam: Verification checklist: 1) rollback reduces retries (riley); 2) probe detects mismatches in canary (toni); 3) alert validates (sam).

riley: Rollback deployed at 11:05, retry rate down 5.4% -> 0.7% in 5m.

toni: PR opened for probe, tests passing.

sam: Will add alert and schedule weekly 'cross-region retry' reviews for 3 weeks. Pinning this thread as canonical follow-up.

net-oncall: RFC uploaded (WIP). Will update when PR is ready.

riley: Marked AI-701 done.

toni: Will update when AI-702 merged and enabled.

sam: Thanks all. Update this thread when each AI closes.
